result.summary: The environment features continuous sidewalks and street lighting but lacks a marked crosswalk at the visible intersection. Parked vehicles along the curb create potential sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the two-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There is a stop bar indicating an intersection, but no marked crosswalk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the left curb block the view between drivers and pedestrians at the crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install zebra-style pavement markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked continental crosswalk and a curb ramp with tactile paving, providing basic accessibility. However, the lack of visible traffic control devices and potential sightline obstructions from the adjacent brick wall and fencing reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The brick wall and chain-link fence on the corner may prevent drivers from seeing pedestrians entering the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: No traffic signals or stop signs are visible to manage vehicle-pedestrian interactions at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extension
interventions.description: Constructing a bulb-out would shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Adding pedestrian-activated flashing lights would increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

result.summary: The environment features wide roadways with sidewalks on both sides and a marked crosswalk on a side street. However, the main thoroughfare lacks a marked crossing at this location, and parked vehicles on the right create potential sightline obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of a marked crosswalk across the primary wide roadway where pedestrians may attempt to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right curb may block the view between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked zebra crosswalk across the main road to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a marked pedestrian crossing at the entrance to a park or institutional area, featuring a wide, well-maintained sidewalk and mature trees. While basic infrastructure like a crosswalk and curb ramp are present, the crossing lacks active signals or physical speed-calming measures to manage traffic speeds.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Mature trees and dense landscaping near the crossing point may obscure pedestrians or cyclists from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the path entrance

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The crossing lacks active warning devices or physical speed control, which increases risk at a location likely to have high pedestrian and cyclist volumes.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing and increase yielding rates.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Construct a raised crosswalk to physically reduce vehicle speeds and improve the visibility of pedestrians at the crossing.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Sightline Improvement
interventions.description: Trim or manage vegetation near the crossing to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
